messages:
sam: hi all, onboarding snag. built runtime from source in dev container but kv_cache_test segfaults on first append. build logs look normal.

sam: quick run output:

sam: ```
$ ./bazel-bin/runtime/tests/kv_cache_test --gtest_filter=KVCache.*
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
#0  0x7f6e9a2b1a in ?? () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcudart.so.12.0
#1  0x55b2a4c3f0 in runtime::kv::Store::append
```

mika: do `ldd` on libredwood_runtime.so to check for missing driver libs. often libnvidia-ml.so.1 missing in our dev images.

sam: yep, ldd shows libnvidia-ml.so.1 => not found. nvidia-smi on node shows Driver 535.86 CUDA 12.2.

tiago: infra usually mounts driver libs into pods but older dev images miss the symlink. try linking the exact lib to libnvidia-ml.so.1 or ask infra to mount.

sam: created a temp symlink to libnvidia-ml.so.535.86, ldd resolves, but now crash points into NVML:

sam: ```
#0  0x7fffb8c2e3 in nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex_v2 () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvidia-ml.so.1
#1  0x55b2a4c3f0 in runtime::gpu::DeviceTracker::init
```

mika: could be calling NVML during static init or before runtime environment set up. grep for global DeviceTracker instances in tests. try running under gdb with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to get full backtrace.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-488: "devcontainer kv_cache NVML segfault" assigned to infra oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-488 :ticket:

olivia: workaround: run test on a node with matching driver version or run inside a stripped container that uses host driver mount. if you need a quick patch, wrap NVML calls behind a lazy init check so tests without GPUs skip early.

sam: thanks — will gdb and grep tests, and link with infra ticket if needed :thumbsup:
